# GigLine Safety & Compliance

> On-site OSHA safety walkthroughs, documentation reviews, and incident response for small manufacturers, warehouses, and contractors in Kernersville, NC and the Piedmont Triad. One engagement. A written report. A clear path forward.

Founder: Vince Lawrence — OSHA 30-Hour Certified, 25+ years in manufacturing, fleet, and warehouse safety, U.S. Navy veteran.
Location: Kernersville, NC 27107
Phone: (336) 329-8899
Email: vince@giglinecompliance.com
Service area: Within 60 miles of Winston-Salem (full Piedmont Triad) plus scheduled engagements in Charlotte and Raleigh metros.

## Core facts

- A GigLine safety walkthrough takes 1–3 hours on-site and delivers a prioritized "Top 10 Fixes" report within 24–48 hours.
- Walkthrough pricing starts at $950. Larger or more complex operations may scope higher. Most small-operation walkthroughs fall in the $950–$1,500 range based on square footage and scope. OSHA Documentation Readiness Reviews start at $750. Compliance Readiness Visits start at $1,500 (combined walkthrough + documentation review). GigLine OSHA-Ready Control System buildouts start at $4,500.
- Documentation review and OSHA Documentation Readiness Review starts at $750. Incident review and corrective action support starts at $900.
- Every engagement is private. Findings never leave the building except in the written report handed to the client. GigLine does not contact OSHA, insurance carriers, or any third party.
- Reports are color-coded: RED (fix this week), AMBER (fix this month), GREEN (reinforce what's working).

## Primary services

- [Safety Walkthrough & Top 10 Fixes Report](https://www.giglinecompliance.com/services): On-site walkthrough with photo-documented findings and OSHA-referenced corrective actions. Starting at $950.
- [OSHA Documentation Readiness Review](https://www.giglinecompliance.com/services): Review of written safety programs, training records, inspection logs. Starting at $750.
- [Incident Review & Corrective Action Support](https://www.giglinecompliance.com/services): Post-incident documentation and corrective action that holds up under OSHA or insurance review. Starting at $900.

## Free resources

- [Top 5 OSHA Violations in Triad Manufacturing &amp; Warehousing &mdash; Free PDF Report](https://www.giglinecompliance.com/assets/gl-lm-001-digital.pdf): One-page reference document. Each of the five most-cited violations in NC small-to-mid-size manufacturing, warehouse, and distribution operations &mdash; with the OSHA citation number, penalty range, what it looks like on the floor, and the corrective fix. Delivered free after submitting the walkthrough request form.
- [90-Second Safety Check](https://www.giglinecompliance.com/safety-check): Six yes-or-no questions mapped to OSHA's most-cited violations. Instant risk score.
- [2026 Heat Stress Action Template](https://www.giglinecompliance.com/heat-guide): Printable daily heat check with trigger levels and required controls for NC operations.
- [HazCom Starter Pack — $29](https://www.giglinecompliance.com/hazcom): Written HazCom program, SDS binder checklist, and training log. Addresses OSHA 29 CFR 1910.1200.
